newsitem.title: UK: R-OPTIONS - UK traded options in quiet festive mood.
newsitem.headline: R-OPTIONS - UK traded options in quiet festive mood.

text.p: The traded options market was at a standstill on Tuesday with most players absent ahead of the two-day Christmas break, dealers said.
"We haven't done a single bargain this morning. There is no one around to do any business," one dealer said.
Marks & Spencer was the most active issue, with a total of 754 contracts in the January 500 calls bought at 4p.
Marks & Spencer shares were up 1/2p at 479-1/2p by 1115 GMT.
